name: weekday_number
description: Map Monday-based weekday numbers to weekday names; matched control copies a number from the same template.
generator_code:
import random,json,calendar
random.seed(0)
items=[]; controls=[]
for i in range(112):
 n=random.randrange(1,8); year=random.randrange(1990,2031)
 pre='Weekday names: 1 = Monday; 2 = Tuesday; 3 = Wednesday; '
 items.append({'prompt':pre+f'{n} =','answer':' '+calendar.day_name[n-1]})
 controls.append({'prompt':pre+f'The year is {year}; the weekday number is {n}; the year again =','answer':' '+str(year)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
